Short-term rental operations, in plain English

Turnover

The clean and reset between one guest’s check-out and the next check-in.

Co-host

Someone the owner authorizes on Airbnb to manage a listing, messages and calendar.

PMS

Property management software, like Hostfully or Guesty, that centralizes bookings, messages and tasks.

Channel manager

Syncs calendars and rates across Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com to prevent double bookings.

Self check-in

Smart lock or lockbox access, with a unique code for each guest.

Check-in window

The hours guests may arrive, set per property with a fixed check-out time.

Post-clean inspection

A checklist and photo review confirming the home is guest-ready.

Maintenance ticket

A tracked repair request with a priority, an owner and a status.

© 2026 Favour Chukwuka | Airbnb & Short-Term Rental Virtual Assistant

The numbers behind a rental’s performance

Occupancy rate

The share of available nights that are booked.

ADR

Average daily rate: average revenue per booked night.

RevPAR

Revenue per available night: occupancy multiplied by ADR.

Dynamic pricing

Rates that adjust daily to demand, seasons and events, using tools like PriceLabs.

Minimum stay

The fewest nights a booking can span, used to protect busy dates.

Orphan day

A gap too short to book. Discounts and stay rules help fill it.

Lead time

How far ahead guests book. It guides far-out premiums and last-minute discounts.

Superhost and Guest Favorite

Airbnb badges for reliable hosts and top-rated listings.
